pages.title: The Alchemy Table
pages.text: To start this travel across the knowledge you need first to get an $(#54fc54)Alchemy Table$().

This station it's going to be your principal tool.$(br2) The use is simple, you need to mix ingredients with the correct quantity of them, all of this it's mixed in an item "base", wait for a while, and you get your concoction.

The recipes can be very complex, so for an easy use $(n)put this book in the lectern the table has, that way you can access all the recipes easily.$()$(br2)Once you have your table ready, the next step it's to gather some $(l:tcots_witcher:alchemy_basics/basic_ingredients)ingredients.
